readme:
# MUSE — AI Creator Showcase
A React and TypeScript frontend built with Vite and Tailwind CSS. It presents fictional AI creator profiles, a social feed, local/mock likes and mock/scripted AI chat. Telegram Mini App support and EN/UA/RU localization are included. The chat uses scripted replies; no live AI API is called. There is no backend, no database, no authentication and no payments.
